value: Something is wrong with my World Map
Short size switching puzzle game using the rpg map size trope as the core mechanic. Inspired by Alice Magic’s video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5_vCtjs1bZ4

Your mom sends you on an errand outside the village. Once you step out of your village you notice something strange about the scale of your surroundings. It seems that whenever you enter the world map the size you appear is your actual size.

By exiting towns from the front entrance, your character becomes as big as they appear in the world, allowing you to traverse the area differently from small size. Opening the map makes you even bigger, leaving a footprint trail wherever you move, overriding the underlying terrain for traversal through otherwise blocked areas.
